summary: Found while clearing ten stale scratch parents out of project-paths.json: nine stayed removed, the bare %TEMP% entry was back within two minutes.

reason: Taking defect 1 (brief option 1): drop the localStorage extraPaths mirror so the durable registry is the only input to list-projects and a removed entry stays removed. Defect 2 (no unregister UI) is an open fork the brief left to the user.
